description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kadawalamadiththa, Kandy Kadawath Hathara and Ganga Wata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320294
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including ownership details, property descriptions, and legal status of various plots. The content focuses on land ownership, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
